assessments.reasoning: The project introduction names an array programming language and lists a C implementation separately. The later introduction locates the design in the APL tradition, and the intervening paragraph identifies a repository-hosted self-hosted compiler.

challenge.method: Compare the separate language, C implementation and self-hosted compiler references. Check whether the APL discussion supplies a shared grammar, dialect assignment or compatibility relation.
challenge.results: The passages distinguish the language from the implementation artifacts. The declared APL tradition describes design context and does not establish a dialect relationship.

limitations: Project-defined language identity only. No compiler conformance, edition, or APL interchangeability follows.
